approved_public_record.title: Verified battery record
approved_public_record.message: Verified public battery facts are available.
approved_public_record.nextAction: Review the critical unknowns and limitations before taking further action.

record_under_review.title: Record under review
record_under_review.message: A possible record exists, but it has not yet completed NewBatteries’ evidence review.
record_under_review.nextAction: Check back after governance review is complete.

record_rights_restricted.title: Record cannot be displayed publicly
record_rights_restricted.message: This record has evidence, but required public display rights are not cleared for key fields.
record_rights_restricted.nextAction: Await rights clearance for critical fields.

record_incomplete.title: Record is incomplete
record_incomplete.message: This record is missing required verified information for safe public output.
record_incomplete.nextAction: Complete and verify required critical fields.

record_disputed.title: Record disputed
record_disputed.message: This record is currently disputed and cannot produce verified public output.

unknown_code.title: Code not found
unknown_code.message: We could not identify this code in the current governed records.
unknown_code.nextAction: Check the code and try again, or provide a photo/label for manual review.

technical_failure.title: Record unavailable
technical_failure.message: The battery record could not be loaded. No compatibility conclusion has been made.
technical_failure.nextAction: Try again later or contact support.

multiple_possible_records.title: Multiple possible records
multiple_possible_records.message: More than one governed record may match. No single verified identification has been returned.
multiple_possible_records.nextAction: Provide additional identifying details to narrow the result.

record_deprecated.title: Record deprecated
record_deprecated.message: This record is deprecated and is not used for new verified public outputs.
record_deprecated.nextAction: Use a current governed record where available.

record_retired.title: Record retired
record_retired.message: This record is retired and cannot produce a verified public output.

malformed_record.title: Record unavailable
malformed_record.message: The record data is incomplete or malformed and no public output can be produced.
malformed_record.nextAction: Re-run record governance checks before publishing.
